rules.rule: BO Lesson Detail shows a Previous Lesson button for the Aver flow.
rules.role_constraint: Visible roles are not specified in the ticket.
rules.conditional_logic: Applies on BO Lesson Detail when the feature is enabled for the tenant.

rules.rule: BO Lesson Detail shows a Next Lesson button for the Aver flow.
rules.role_constraint: Visible roles are not specified in the ticket.
rules.conditional_logic: Applies on BO Lesson Detail when the feature is enabled for the tenant.

rules.rule: Clicking Previous Lesson redirects the user to the previous lesson detail in the same recurring lesson schedule.
rules.role_constraint: User must already be able to open BO Lesson Detail.
rules.conditional_logic: Only when a previous lesson exists in the same lesson schedule chain.

rules.rule: Clicking Next Lesson redirects the user to the next lesson detail in the same recurring lesson schedule.
rules.role_constraint: User must already be able to open BO Lesson Detail.
rules.conditional_logic: Only when a next lesson exists in the same lesson schedule chain.

rules.rule: When the current lesson is in the middle of the recurring chain, Previous Lesson and Next Lesson are both enabled.
rules.conditional_logic: Current lesson has both previous and next lessons in the same chain.

rules.rule: When the current lesson is the first lesson in the chain, Previous Lesson is disabled.
rules.conditional_logic: Current lesson has no previous lesson in the same chain.

rules.rule: When the current lesson is the last lesson in the chain, Next Lesson is disabled.
rules.conditional_logic: Current lesson has no next lesson in the same chain.

rules.rule: Navigation keeps the user on the same browser tab and reuses the BO detail surface rather than opening a new tab.
rules.conditional_logic: Applies whenever either navigation button is clicked.

rules.rule: Aver label mapping uses 前の特訓 for Previous Lesson and 次の特訓 for Next Lesson.
Core label mapping uses 前の授業 for Previous Lesson and 次の授業 for Next Lesson.
rules.conditional_logic: Applies in Core scope if the feature is not Aver-only.
